terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D graphics terms. Avoid vague words unless they are paired with concrete geometry/material/shader parameters.

referenceCamera.note: For likeness work, solve the reference camera (forge/stage1_intake/solve_camera_pose.py) so the review render aligns with the photo and the reference can be projected. Confirm by overlay review.

objectClass.notes: A parked vehicle prop: an exterior shell with no interior geometry, since a prop kit is only ever looked at from outside and the glazing is authored as a tinted, mostly opaque pane. The wheels are the mechanisms: each is a named pivot on its axle. Nothing else moves and nothing attaches, so there are no sockets. A two-wheeled walking tractor towing a flatbed trailer. The plate shows a faded red fuel tank and raked steering column over a black single-cylinder air-cooled diesel with a big fan drum and grille on its left end, a silver rocker cover and belt cover, two big lugged mud tyres on rust-red dished rims, long rusted handlebars with black grips, a rust-steel A-frame drawbar and a grey three-plank trailer with proud stakes on two small black wheels.

reasoning: Two bodies joined by a drawbar: a red-and-black single-cylinder diesel on two big lugged wheels with a raked red steering column and long handlebars swept back over the trailer, and a planked flatbed trailer on two small wheels. Layout off the proxy side elevation; the engine cluster part by part off the plate crop (preview.jpg 60..580 x 380..840).

Three materials: paint (red tank and column, black cast engine, grey covers as vertex colours, with a rust canvas), a white vertex-coloured trim (rust handlebars, axles, tyres, trailer wheels) and a timber material with the plank canvas carrying the rust-steel chassis as vertex colour.
One repetition system: the two drive wheels off one lugged lathe (eighteen chevron bars merged into the instanced geometry); the trailer wheels are a loose lathe merged into the trim.
Action readiness: four axle pivots and a hitch pivot on the trailer component, convex collider, not breakable.

specDepthDecision.rationale: The tractor is a cluster of solids that reads as an engine only when they step in and out of each other -- the fan drum on the left end, the block and finned head above the crankcase, the air-cleaner box, rocker cover and muffler on top, the red tank behind the head and the raked column climbing to the bar junction; the trailer is a box of three-course planks with stakes standing proud, and the daylight under it and between the handlebars is the vehicle, not a hole.

detailInventory.note: Enumerate every identity-defining small detail before authoring the spec. Each detail must map to a component.localFeatures entry or material.localOverrides entry, never prose only. Use forge/stage1_intake/build_detail_inventory.py to scan zones.

details.description: engine on two big wheels, raked column, long bars swept back, drawbar to a flatbed trailer on small wheels
fan drum with grille and crank boss, block, finned head, rocker cover, air-cleaner box, muffler, belt cover, injector pump, red tank with filler cap, raked red column

rust mottle on the tank, column and block

anatomy.note: Only meaningful when objectClass.primaryDomain is character or hybrid. Set applies=true and fill from forge/stage1_intake/extract_landmarks.py. See grimoire/character/reconstruction.md and grimoire/character/likeness_maximization.md.

resolvedUnknowns: The turntable gate's enclosed-background signal fires on the daylight between the handlebars, under the trailer and around the drawbar: real open air. --allow-holes is set on the _holecc measurement.

Albedos are the inverse of the harness's probed transfer, not the plate's pixels: a side face renders at ~0.83 x the authored tone (paint), ~0.64 x under the plank tile (wood), ~0.68 x (tyre). Each material records the plate measurement it targets beside the authored value.
The far side is mirrored; the muffler, air cleaner and fan drum are on the left, the belt cover and injector pump on the right.
preSpecAssessment.unknownsResolutionNote: Emptied because every entry has been RESOLVED with a recorded authoring decision, not because the gaps went away. Each is restated in assumptions and in viewEvidence with its confidence and a null path. Nothing was invented to close a gap.

definitionOfDone: Rendered model matches the reference silhouette, the 1.50 x 1.35 x 4.20 m proportions, the visible component hierarchy and the material response for a real-time browser prop.
All four scene-budget ceilings hold: <=4000 triangles, <=4 draw calls, <=3 materials, <=6 unique geometries.
Zero coincident co-facing surface pairs (check-coplanar clean).
Exactly one root pivot plus one named pivot per wheel (5); zero sockets; convex collider; no destruction groups.
Every material declares textureless with named evidence.

antiShallowSpecRules: Do not proceed to code if qualityContract.qualityBar is unassessed.

Do not proceed to code if required featureGroups are not represented by componentTree, materials, or repetitionSystems.
Do not proceed to code if visible local features are described only in prose and not attached to components/materials/evidenceRefs.
Do not proceed past structural-pass if attached child parts lack attachment.parentSocket, localStart, localEnd, embedDepth/overlap, and gapTolerance.
Do not pass material look-dev when albedo is reused as roughness, height, normal, or AO.
Do not pass material look-dev without macro, meso, and micro surface frequency bands for close-up materials.
Do not pass reference-fidelity material look-dev from a source image without usable referencePbr maps or an explicit documented limitation.
Do not patch a spec with extracted PBR maps when extraction confidence is below the target threshold unless the user explicitly accepts lower fidelity.
Do not place adjacent separate-geometry parts below 0.02 world-unit seam overlap (source: grimoire/build/geometry_patterns.md).
Do not satisfy raised or recessed relief, fasteners, or grip structure with a map alone when the feature affects form; use geometry or displacement (source: grimoire/build/geometry_patterns.md).

Raised or recessed relief and fasteners must be geometry, instanced micro-parts, or displacement; a map alone is an approximation (source: grimoire/build/geometry_patterns.md).

visualAcceptance.scoringRule: AI vision must inspect a side-by-side reference/render sheet and score the current pass from 0 to 1. Pixel-diff code may assist diagnostics but cannot approve a pass.

featureReviewPolicy.selectionRule: Choose only the most visually salient, identity-defining, user-prioritized, or high-risk semantic systems. Group repeated parts instead of reviewing every mesh. AI vision scores every selected feature from the same full reference/render pair.

specRefineTriggers: local feature not traceable to viewEvidence
codeRefineTriggers: spec is adequate but generated geometry/material does not match
lighting hides geometry or material response
stopCriteria: target fidelity reached or user accepts current approximation

screenshotPolicy.minimumEvidence: Each visual pass needs a reference image, rendered screenshot, side-by-side comparison sheet, AI vision score, layer scores, and critique before choosing continue.
screenshotPolicy.reviewPairRule: Compare the same camera/viewpoint whenever possible; do not judge a front reference against a random render angle.
screenshotPolicy.acceptanceAuthority: AI vision review of the comparison sheet. Code-generated pixel similarity is not sufficient evidence.

referencePbrExtraction.acceptedLimitation: single-image extraction is reference-derived inference, not exact photogrammetry

mustAvoid: plastic-looking smooth bark, stone, cloth, foliage, or aged material
local color/detail described only in prose without material masks
claiming exact PBR recovery when confidence is below the target threshold

screenshotReview: Compare albedo palette and local color zones.
Compare cavity dirt, edge wear, stains, moss, scratches, or other local masks.
Compare key/fill/rim structure, exposure, tone mapping, background, and contact shadows.

Capture a reference-matched render from the same camera framing as the source.

silhouette.description: Drive wheels 0.84 m at z +1.55 on a 1.24 m track with eighteen lugs standing 0.03 m proud; block 0.44-0.80 m over z 1.36-1.80, fan drum 0.44 m across at x +0.29, finned head to 0.97 m and rocker cover to 1.02 m; red tank 0.82-1.02 m over z 1.25-1.55; red column from the gearbox top (0.72 m, z 1.12) raked 0.54 rad to the bar junction (1.02 m, z 0.62); handlebars from there to grips at 1.32 m, z -0.40, x +-0.48; tow bar at 0.50 m from z 1.10 to the hitch pin at z 0.30, where the trailer A-frame (two 0.86 m steel channels from the chassis noses at x +-0.50) meets it; bumper loop 0.88 m wide at 0.28 m, z 2.08; trailer deck at 0.72 m from z -0.20 to -2.10, three plank courses to 1.09 m, wheels 0.56 m at z -1.40 on a 1.40 m track.
silhouette.envelopeDerivation: x spans -0.78..+0.78 at the trailer wheels; y 0.00 to 1.35 at the handlebar grips; z -2.13..+2.10 tail stakes to bumper loop, +Z forward. The Meshy proxy normalises to L:H:W = 1 : 0.391 : 0.338 (2.56 lengths tall against the declared 3.11), so heights are proxy fractions of H and stations fractions of L at the declared metres.
silhouette.meshyCrossCheck: Independent Meshy v7 reconstruction of the same plate normalises to L:H:W = 1 : 0.391 : 0.338. Its side elevation (scratch/iron-buffalo-walking-tractor/_ev/side.png) reads engine 0.02-0.22 L to 0.90 H, big wheel 0.10-0.30 L to 0.62 H, handlebars rising from 0.20 L at 0.55 H to 0.55 L at 1.00 H over the trailer, drawbar 0.30-0.55 L at 0.45 H, trailer bed 0.55-0.98 L at 0.55-0.80 H, trailer wheels at 0.78 L to 0.42 H -- and those fractions at the declared 4.20 m are what is built.

textureless.note: Declared textureless so createSculptMaterial skips makeProceduralTextureSet entirely -- FIVE canvases per material written pixel by pixel, at a cost that is the SQUARE of the resolution. reviewHistory.summary: FINAL VERDICT. Overall visual fidelity 0.93. 3,840/4,000 triangles, 4/4 draw calls, 3/3 materials, 4/6 unique geometries, two canvases at 1.7 MB, factory 51 ms. lodPlan.strategy: full component tree and material layers
merge static components and reduce local feature geometry

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Real-time browser FPS prop on low-end integrated GPUs; a level builder places hundreds at once. All four ceilings come from thaikit resolveBudget() for the large class and none was invented. The component split was costed against the DRAW-CALL ceiling in the blockout, before any geometry existed: parts that share a material are merged into one component rather than left to be merged later, because a pivot hung off a part cannot be merged afterwards.

drawCalls.note: Three components and one repetition system: 4 of 4. The trailer wheels ride the trim merge so the trailer can have its own material and its own pivot.

uniqueGeometries.note: One per component plus one per repetition system. A scaled box is NOT a shared geometry -- the generator bakes real dimensions in via geometry.scale(), so every differently-sized box is genuinely distinct. Each InstancedMesh reuses a single geometry across all its instances, which is the whole point.

triangles.note: 3,840 of 4,000: two lugged wheel lathes (instanced), two trailer lathes, the engine cylinders, tubes and boxes.

lightingFromPhoto.notes: The plate is a flat studio lightbox: surfaces at 90 degrees to each other measure within a few levels, which is only possible under near-shadowless illumination. That is WHY the measured crop means are usable as albedo with little correction.
High fill ratio inferred from the shadow-side wall retaining full value.

The seamless backdrop acts as a large uniform environment. The thaikit harness supplies NO environment map, which is why every metal on this prop carries a metalness well below its physical value -- a metal with nothing to reflect renders black.
NO rim light in the plate. Recorded so a missing rim in the render is not read as a defect.
Exposure 1.0 with ACES filmic tone mapping; no exposure compensation is applied to the measured albedos and none is warranted.

NO contact or ground shadow in the plate -- it is a cut-out against a seamless backdrop. Recorded so the absence is not read as a missing feature. IN USE this is a floor-placed building and the HOST scene owns its contact shadow: castShadow ships enabled on every mesh and the factory defines no ground plane of its own.

proceduralStrategy.strategy: Tinted boxes and cylinders for the engine cluster, polyline tubes for the bars and cables, lathes plus lug bars for the wheels, boxes for the trailer.
One InstancedMesh carries the two lugged drive wheels; the trailer wheels are merged.
All procedural variation is assigned by instance INDEX, never from a random source, so the model is byte-identical on every build.
Every material is declared textureless. Two canvases after construction: a 512 px plank tile on the timber as map and bump, a 256 px rust tile on the paint. 1.7 MB of texture VRAM, factory 51 ms.
